baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance installs a boundary: فرق separates and distinguishes, while repeated بين marks both the interval between the parties and the linkage now being cut.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance makes the boundary an enacted declaration rather than an unspoken judgment.
Separation by distinction supplies the cut that ends the shared relation.
The interval between two parties spatializes the newly marked relational gap.
A linkage joining parties makes the named gap the rupture of an existing bond.

changed_reading.before: A simple announcement that the two will part.
changed_reading.after: A speech-act converts an existing bond into a marked interval and formally ends it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The future promise couples delivered news with return to an end-result, so the coming account recovers what the opaque events issue into rather than merely paraphrasing them.

activation_trace.role: Consequential news makes the promised account an informative arrival.
Return to an outcome makes intelligibility reside in what the events become.

changed_reading.before: He will explain what the puzzling actions mean.
changed_reading.after: He will bring the actions back to their end-results, where their intelligibility becomes visible.

baseline_models.mechanism: Negated capacity governs patience: ordinary self-restraint becomes a load-bearing boundary around material that has not yet reached its disclosed outcome.

activation_trace.role: Practical ability frames the failure as insufficient capacity, not merely unwillingness.
Holding the self against distress supplies the primary discipline under pressure.
Bounding sides recast patience as containment of unresolved appearances.

changed_reading.before: You became impatient with what you saw.
changed_reading.after: You lacked the capacity to contain unresolved appearances until their outcome could be disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relation begins at a gathering place, becomes intentional following for instruction, and is placed under a no-companionship condition; the focus separation is the inverse completion of that assembled relation.

activation_trace.role: Relational separation realizes the terminus of the prior alignment.
A site defined by gathering makes the encounter begin at convergence.
Following behind constitutes the requested pedagogical alignment.
Continued companionship names the relation whose termination Musa conditions.

structural_cues: 18:60-66 moves from a gathering place to requested following; 18:76 preauthorizes an end to companionship.
The demonstrative هَذَا presents the current objection as the realized boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies convergence, following, conditional companionship, and separation; I infer an inverse arc from assembled apprenticeship to formal closure. A live alternative is that هَذَا points only to the latest exchange, not the whole arc.

changed_reading.before: The declaration ends a personal association.
changed_reading.after: The declaration formally closes a deliberately assembled teaching relation whose termination had already been made conditional.

context_deltas.mechanism: The missing patience is the capacity to suspend judgment while inward knowledge is absent: complete epistemic enclosure has not formed, so visible acts exceed the observer's holding boundary.

activation_trace.role: Ability makes patience an epistemic capacity that can fail.
Bounding sides supply the image of holding an unresolved case within limits.
Knowledge disclosed to one knower establishes the asymmetry the learner must endure.
Complete enclosure in knowledge defines precisely what the observer lacks.
Knowledge of an affair's interior identifies the missing depth behind surface judgment.

structural_cues: 18:68 directly asks how patience is possible without encompassing خبر.
The ability-patience formula recurs in 18:67, 18:72, 18:75, and 18:82.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lack of encompassing inward knowledge and repeated failed patience; I infer that patience functions as provisional epistemic containment. The materially bounded image comes from the cited صبر branch; ordinary self-restraint remains the primary alternative.

changed_reading.before: The learner fails an emotional test of patience.
changed_reading.after: The learner cannot hold apparent wrong within an unresolved interval until access to its inward causal structure arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three explanations return visible injury to deferred protective outcomes: a breach averts seizure, a loss opens onto replacement, and a wall delays extraction of preserved wealth until its owners mature.

activation_trace.role: Return to outcome anchors the case-wise movement from deed to protected result.
A literal breach supplies the visible injury later reclassified by its result.
Coercive seizure supplies the threatened endpoint that makes damage protective.
One thing taking another's place makes replacement the second case's deferred horizon.
Stored wealth supplies the concealed interest preserved by the wall.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the delayed completion of the third case.

structural_cues: The repeated أَمَّا partitions 18:79-82 into three matched deed-outcome cases.
Each case crosses a temporal gap between present appearance and a protected future.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies each deed and stated end; I infer that endpoint reclassifies the deed's apparent function without erasing the deed. A live alternative is that تأويل reports particular motives without establishing a general end-based method.

changed_reading.before: تأويل is a generic explanation of three puzzling choices.
changed_reading.after: تأويل is a disciplined return from each visible act to the future it protects, thereby changing the act's causal and moral classification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing account separates will, deed, and authorization: the Lord wills, the speaker acts, and the speaker denies autonomous command. تأويل therefore audits agency as well as consequences.

activation_trace.role: Distinct facets let separation differentiate kinds of agency within one event.
Governance and setting an affair right make the promised account jurisdictional rather than merely private.
Authority or office marks the denied source of autonomous authorization.
Will and intention identify the purposive source named for the third act.
The production of an act distinguishes execution from the authority behind it.

structural_cues: 18:82 shifts from رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَا to وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي immediately before naming تأويل.
The first-person actor remains grammatically present while personal initiative is denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine willing, first-person doing, and denial of personal command; I infer a jurisdictional boundary among purpose, execution, and authorization. A live alternative is the narrower claim that the speaker only denies personal initiative.

changed_reading.before: The speaker personally explains why he made puzzling choices.
changed_reading.after: The account distinguishes executor, purpose, and authorizing command, presenting تأويل as an audit of governed action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A route is recovered by following remaining marks, and the promised informing reenacts that operation on the three deeds through sequential report: explanation becomes guided retracing from appearance to consequence.

activation_trace.role: A clear route makes informing function as guidance through the cases.
An extended traversable path supplies the narrative's earlier route image.
Moving behind a prior trace supplies the method of recovering what was passed.
A report led in sequence turns physical retracing into an explanatory procedure.

structural_cues: 18:64 explicitly reverses movement along prior traces.
18:79-82 revisits the acts in their original order under repeated أَمَّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, trace-following, sequential report, and a promised informing; I infer that the account reproduces retracing at an epistemic level. A live alternative is ordinary ordered narration without a route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The speaker will state an explanation after ending the journey.
changed_reading.after: The speaker will guide the listener back through the acts along a resolvable route from visible trace to hidden outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant و ل ي mapping for تأويل and is therefore form-distant; it remains anchored to that focus token and gains relational support from following and companionship. Render only as secondary wordplay: embodied succession turns away and verbal succession takes over, not as a morphological claim.

activation_trace.role: The explicit cut provides the relational turn in the handoff.
Turning away supplies the cessation side of the secondary activation.
Unbroken succession supplies the account that immediately replaces shared travel.
Following behind identifies the embodied mode that is ending.
Continued companionship supplies the relation replaced by verbal disclosure.

changed_reading.after: The goodbye is a handoff in pedagogical medium: bodily following turns away and an ordered verbal account succeeds it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates the material branch in which a liquid thickens at its end, so it is an analogy rather than the primary lexical reading of تأويل. It remains focus-anchored and is echoed by sea, wall, and stored treasure; downstream prose should mark the events as if settling into a determinate configuration, not claim literal derivation.

activation_trace.role: A fluid setting into thickness at its end supplies the contained material analogy for resolved events.
Expansive water supplies the initially fluid and difficult-to-bound field.
A raised wall supplies the fixed boundary around the final preserved interest.
Compact fullness supplies the concealed core that becomes determinate in the account.

changed_reading.before: تأويل verbally decodes already fixed acts.
changed_reading.after: The account lets apparently fluid events set into a bounded configuration around the interests they preserve.

strongest_changes: Separation closes an intentionally assembled teaching relation but immediately changes, rather than ends, the transmission of knowledge.
Failed patience becomes failed epistemic containment while the inward causal structure remains unavailable.
تأويل returns each visible deed to a protected future and distinguishes deed, purpose, and authorizing command.
summary.what_was_special: The focus syntax makes rupture the threshold of disclosure: companionship stops precisely when a traceable account of outcomes and agency can begin.
remaining_uncertainties: هَذَا may point narrowly to the latest objection rather than retrospectively to the whole apprenticeship.
The و ل ي succession and material-setting activations are packet-licensed but intentionally secondary and form-distant.
